description:
Get the COMPLETE dataset of an X-Matrix in one call: strategicContext (the purpose of the organization, the vision, context and tradeoffs of this matrix, the vision of the matrix above: read it first, it says why; a draft in it is a proposal nobody validated yet), then every element of all four quadrants (id, title, status, progress, externalRef, indicator type, target and current value), each KPI's last 8 readings by period (oldest first, to read the trend), each element's last 3 progress updates with comments, all correlations (from/to element ids and titles, strength), and the completeness score.

Each initiative (south) carries its sheet (why, expected result, milestones, next action, health and its sentence, blockers), each KPI (west) its definition (formula, source system and reference, data owner, frequency), and each reading its status: provisional while its period runs, final once it ended.

For anything you will show outside the organization, pass audience "external": the same filter as a public link applies, so you never have to decide yourself what may leave. Each initiative carries pageUrl, its page in the app: cite it as the reference version in what you build.

Use this instead of get_matrix_summary when you need the full matrix — typically to render a view or build an interactive artifact (e.g. an X-Matrix cockpit for a leadership meeting, shareable with the team). The matrix_artifact prompt shows the recommended artifact layout.

audience.description: external for anything that will be shown outside the organization (a board deck, an investor update, a partner): leaves out the elements marked internal and their correlations, every value, target, unit, link, name, reading, update and KPI definition; a sheet keeps why, the expected result, milestones, the next action and the health; the score counts what is shown. Default internal: everything.

lang.description: Two-letter language to read the purpose of the organization in, when it is translated (default: the language of the account).

matrix_id.description: UUID of the matrix (default: the default matrix of the organization). Pass it as soon as list_matrices shows more than one.

name: get_matrix_data
title: Get full matrix data
